description: Manufacturing-risk leakage remediation. Removes leaked manufacturing_risk (derived from post-decision CRL notes) and adds placeholders for T-1 compliant inspection/CMC proxies (s21/s22/s23).

t1_compliance.notes: manufacturing_risk removed because it was derived from post-decision CRL reason text.

disabled_features.name: manufacturing_risk
disabled_features.reason: T-1 leakage: populated from post-decision CRL notes (CMC keyword).

s21_form_483_oai.definition: 1.0 if any OAI inspection for sponsor/manufacturing facility within lookback window pre-PDUFA; else 0.0
s21_form_483_oai.t1_gating: Only inspections with InspectionEndDate <= catalyst_date - 1 day

s22_cmc_citations.definition: Scaled citation density/severity proxy computed from Form 483 citations pre-PDUFA (e.g., log1p(citation_count)/k)
s22_cmc_citations.t1_gating: Only citations tied to inspections with InspectionEndDate <= catalyst_date - 1 day

s23_inspection_trend.definition: Scaled trend metric from pre-PDUFA inspection classifications (OAI/VAI/NAI severity over time).
s23_inspection_trend.t1_gating: Only inspections with InspectionEndDate <= catalyst_date - 1 day

audit_trail.change: Disabled/removed manufacturing_risk due to confirmed leakage.
audit_trail.evidence: manufacturing_risk derived from post-decision CRL notes (CMC keywording).
